title: Bengaluru Landlord Security Deposit Withheld
user_story: I vacated my 2BHK flat in HSR Layout, Bengaluru on October 31st after giving 1 month notice as per agreement. I paid ₹65,000 deposit via Google Pay in 2023. The landlord inspected the house and confirmed everything was fine on WhatsApp. Now it's been over 25 days and he is refusing to return my deposit, saying he needs ₹40,000 for full house repainting and deep cleaning, but the house only had normal wear and tear. He is not answering my calls now.

user_details.property_address: Flat 302, Green Glen Apartments, HSR Layout Sector 2, Bengaluru 560102

title: E-Commerce Refusal to Refund Damaged Appliance
user_story: I ordered a semi-automatic washing machine for ₹18,499 from QuickMart on 5th Nov. When delivery arrived on 8th Nov, the motor drum was badly dented and making loud grinding noises. I immediately created a return request with photos within 2 hours. Customer service closed the ticket saying 'Damage not reported at delivery time'. I escalated via email three times with unboxing video, but they keep sending automated rejection emails.

title: Unpaid Salary and Relieving Letter Withheld by Employer
user_story: I worked as a frontend engineer at Apex Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd in Gurugram for 1.5 years. I submitted my resignation on September 1st and served my full 30-day notice period till September 30th with handover done. My company has not paid my September salary (₹60,000) and August arrears (₹45,000), total ₹1,05,000. HR is not releasing my relieving letter or experience certificate, claiming the client project had bugs. My new employer is threatening to revoke my offer if I don't submit relieving letter.

title: Dubious Recovery Agent Police Arrest Threat (Escalation Case)
user_story: A man claiming to be Inspector Rathore from Crime Branch called me and sent a PDF on WhatsApp with a fake police seal, claiming an FIR has been lodged against me for non-payment of a ₹15,000 loan app debt and police will come to arrest me and my parents today if I don't transfer ₹25,000 immediately to a personal UPI ID.

title: Gym Branch Abrupt Closure Refund (Hinglish)
user_story: Maine 12 months ka gym membership liya tha ₹16,000 pay karke FitZone Gym me. 2 months baad unhone achanak branch band kar di aur bola dusre branch 12 km door jao. Maine refund manga WhatsApp pe toh branch manager ne block kar diya aur bolte hain 'No refund policy'. Mere paas payment receipt aur unka WhatsApp message hai.
